# KaTeX 0.19.1

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.1.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.19.1
License: MIT; upstream LICENSE is included unchanged.

The JavaScript and WOFF2 fonts are unmodified. The CSS removes only WOFF/TTF fallback URLs because VS Code supports WOFF2; all referenced WOFF2 files are bundled. Runtime uses local extension resources only, with trust=false. No CDN, remote math service or TeX installation is required for this reading aid.
